retrieved.title: Sample study: AI tutoring and grade 8 algebra outcomes
retrieved.excerpt: In a sample evaluation of 212 grade 8 students across six classrooms, students using the AI tutor completed homework sets 22 percent faster than students in comparison classrooms. On a unit test, scores were similar between groups. On a transfer task with unfamiliar problem...
retrieved.text: In a sample evaluation of 212 grade 8 students across six classrooms, students using the AI tutor completed homework sets 22 percent faster than students in comparison classrooms. On a unit test, scores were similar between groups. On a transfer task with unfamiliar problem types, students using the tutor scored slightly lower than the comparison group. Classrooms were not randomly assigned, and the study ran for eight weeks.
